invariants: Planning and validation are free of paid side effects.
Paid execution requires an approved immutable run snapshot.
Successful outputs are immutable and preserve lineage.
A failed node cannot erase successful sibling outputs.
Consent and rights are scoped, auditable and revocable.
Provider outputs are persisted before remote URLs expire.
Secrets never enter client bundles, prompts or logs.
